title: Calculate power of a lens

hook.scenario: Aap eye doctor ke paas gaye aur usne prescription par likha: '+2.0 D'.
hook.question: Chashme ka yeh +2.0 number kya darshata (indicate) hai?

mental_model.intuition: Lens ki taqat (Power) uski focal length ki ulti (reciprocal) hoti hai.
mental_model.description: Jo lens light ko jitna jaldi (paas mein) bend karega, uski focal length utni choti hogi aur uski Power utni hi zyada hogi. Formula hai: P = 1/f (f hamesha meters mein hona chahiye).

explanation:
Kissi bhi lens ki asli kshamta (ability) yeh hai ki wo light ko kitna jyada bend, yaani converge ya diverge kar sakta hai. Is degree of convergence/divergence ko hum 'Power of a Lens' (P) kehte hain.

Jitni kam focal length (f) hogi, light utni hi jaldi bend hogi, aur isliye Power zyada hogi. Mathematically, Power is defined as the reciprocal of focal length. Iska formula hai: P = 1 / f. Yahan par ek strict rule hai: focal length (f) humesha meters (m) mein honi chahiye. Agar f centimeters mein di hai, toh usko pehle 100 se divide karke meter mein convert karna padega, ya phir directly formula P = 100 / f (in cm) use kar sakte hain.

Power ki SI unit 'Dioptre' hoti hai, jise 'D' se darshaya jata hai. 1 Dioptre us lens ki power hai jiski focal length exactly 1 meter hai.

Signs yahan bhi apply hote hain. Convex lens ki focal length positive hoti hai, toh uski power bhi positive (+D) hoti hai. Concave lens ki focal length negative hoti hai, isliye uski power negative (-D) hoti hai. Jab doctor +2.0D likhta hai, uska seedha matlab hai Convex lens.

key_points.title: Power Formula
key_points.detail: P = 1 / f (where f is in meters). If f is in cm, use P = 100 / f.

key_points.title: Sign Relation
key_points.detail: Power of a convex lens is positive (+). Power of a concave lens is negative (-).

worked_example.problem: Find the power of a concave lens of focal length 2 m.

steps.narration: Focal length pehle se meters mein hai. Concave ka matlab negative f hai.

worked_example.problem: A doctor prescribes a corrective lens of power +1.5 D. Find the focal length of the lens and identify its type.

steps.narration: Equation ko rearrange karke f nikaalein.
Value ko meters mein calculate karein.
Positive power ka matlab hai ki yeh convex lens hai.

common_mistakes.title: Forgetting to convert cm to meters
common_mistakes.explanation: Sabse badi mistake! Agar question mein f = 20 cm diya hai, aur bachha P = 1/20 = 0.05 D likh de, toh galat hai. P = 100/20 = +5 D sahi answer hai.

recall_questions.q: What is the SI unit of power of a lens?
Does a concave lens have positive or negative power?

oa_questions.question: A lens has a power of -2.5 D. What is the focal length and nature of the lens?
oa_questions.answer: Focal length = -40 cm, Nature = Concave lens.
oa_questions.approach: P = -2.5. f = 1/P = 1/-2.5 = -0.4 m = -40 cm. Minus sign means concave.

oa_questions.question: Find the power of a concave lens of focal length 2 m.
oa_questions.approach: Concave lens has negative f, so f = -2 m. P = 1 / -2 = -0.5 D.
